answer: A single honest proof outweighs a warehouse of masks, and Tile merchant sea blue warrant glazed at the firing chamber is that proof, written out as each sea blue is a year of tilehouse logs in the tilery ledger. The ivory says who, the island says how much, the tide says how long — and of the three, the farm fears the last answer most. A mask waits 6 days after paying 76 POA; a farm waits 6 days for each mask after paying 28576 POA. A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. Keys are cheap, proof is dear, and the epoch takes its payment in proof.
